parked.spanish: Y fueron entregados desde miles de Israel, mil a la tribu, doce mil extractos de ejército.

findings.issue: חֲלוּצֵי is a qal passive participle, masculine plural construct (H2502 b): people drawn out or equipped, in construct with the army. «extractos» is a result-noun (excerpts/extracts), so it drops the passive participial force and the human participants and adds a concept the tokens do not license.

parked.spanish: Y ahora, maten todo macho en el niño, y toda mujer conociente varón a yacer de macho, maten.

findings.issue: בַּטָּף is the definite collective little-ones; 'el niño' is one child, so 'todo macho en el niño' moves the males from among that group into a single child.
Feminine singular qal participle 'knowing' is smoothed into the nonstandard 'conociente'; the woman remains the one who knows.
Construct noun לְמִשְׁכַּב (bed/lying) plus זָכָר is smoothed to the infinitive 'a yacer de macho'; the lying-of-a-male relation remains.

parked.spanish: Y todo el niño en las mujeres que no conocieron yacer de macho, hagan vivir a ustedes.

findings.issue: «hagan vivir a ustedes» makes the addressees the patient of the hiphil. The child is the one caused to live; לָכֶם is only the beneficiary.

parked.spanish: Y ustedes, acampen a fuera al campamento siete días; todo matante alma, y todo tocante en el herido, se pecarán en el día el tercero y en el día el séptimo, ustedes y sus cautivos.

findings.issue: Hithpael imperfect 2mp of חטא licenses “purify/cleanse yourselves”; “se pecarán” is “will sin” and reverses the stem.
חלל (2491a) is the slain/pierced; “herido” is a wounded person and omits the slain.
מִחוּץ לְ is “outside the camp”; “a fuera al” is a calque that can be read as toward the camp.
שְׁבִי is singular (captivity/captives as a collective); “cautivos” is plural.
